systems.system: Base de dados do registo civil (national civil registration database)

note: The law obliges health units to send birth data to the civil registry within 72 hours, electronically where possible; it names no health information system or exchange in service, and civil registration is not a health system.

facts.fact: Radio Nacional de Angola, relayed by Foco Saude, reports hospital directors and the National Director of Hospitals saying there is no integrated health information system, so patients are registered repeatedly and referrals fail for lack of shared data between hospitals.
